title: tcw-bucknell-1996-world-heavyweight
label: Dr. Doom

won.source: The fed's own first house show: its on-air 'President' character named Dr. Doom the first-ever TCW World Champion after finalist Masked Bulldog was ruled unable to compete.

how: Named the tournament's champion when finalist Masked Bulldog was medically written out of the final, awarded the title without a match.
note: The fed's own broadcast team notes he will still have to beat Masked Bulldog for the belt the following week; no later document in the held record records that match.
